## Instructions for the AI agent

Add the Pricing block to this project exactly as specified here. If the user did not say which variant, ask, or install the first one.

1. **Setup first.** Look for `ui/styles/kit.css` in the folder the `@/` import alias points to (`src/` in most Next.js apps, otherwise the project root). If it is missing, apply the one-time setup first: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/setup.md
2. **Install these components first**, in this order, skipping any already in `ui/components/`. Follow each one's doc, or run the download script below, which covers all of them:
   - `accordion`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/accordion.md
   - `animated-counter`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/animated-counter.md
   - `badge`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/badge.md
   - `button`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/button.md
   - `table`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/table.md
   - `toggle-group`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/toggle-group.md
3. **Shared files.** Create the files under [Shared files](#shared-files) at their exact paths (the download script covers them).
4. **Register the CSS.** In `ui/styles/kit.css`, add these lines directly above the `@source` line, skipping any already there:

   ```css
   @import "./components/accordion.css";
   @import "./components/animated-counter.css";
   @import "./components/badge.css";
   @import "./components/button.css";
   @import "./components/table.css";
   @import "./components/toggle-group.css";
   ```

5. **Create the block.** Save the variant verbatim as its own file, for example `components/blocks/pricing/<variant>.tsx` inside the `@/` folder, then render it from a page. Change the copy (names, prices, links) only if the user asks.

**Rules.** Copy every file verbatim: do not restyle, rename classes, reformat, "improve", convert to another styling approach (CSS modules, styled-components, inline styles) or add npm packages. React and Tailwind CSS v4 only. Keep `'use client'` lines where they are. If a file already exists with identical contents, leave it. Fetch this doc and the source files as raw text (for example with `curl`), not through a summarising web reader: the code must arrive character for character.

## Specification

### Block: Pricing

Marketing sections for a pricing page: three plan cards with a monthly/yearly switch, a feature comparison table and an FAQ. Built only from ui-kit components plus Tailwind utilities; each variant is one self-contained file.

#### Anatomy
```
Three tiers (client)               <section aria-labelledby>, @container, rounded-xl border, bg-background, py 56, px 20 → 40 (@2xl)
  background                       ONE subtle wash: radial-gradient(60% 40% at 50% 0%, primary 9% → transparent)
  intro (centred, max 42rem)       outline Badge “Pricing” · h2 28px → 34px (@2xl) · 15px muted lead
    SegmentedControl               aria-label “Billing period”: Monthly | Yearly  + success Badge sm “Save 20% yearly”
  <ul aria-label="Plans">          3 columns from @3xl, stacked below; 16px gap; mt 48
    <li data-plan>                 rounded-xl, 1px border, bg-card, p-24, gap 24
      name (h3 17px/600) + solid Badge “Most popular” on the recommended plan
      description 13px muted
      price: AnimatedNumber (USD, no decimals) 34px/600 display + “/ seat”; billing note 13px muted
      Button full width: primary on the recommended plan, outline on the others
      feature list: top border, 10px gap, check icon (primary-text) + text
  footnote centred 13px muted with a link

Comparison (server-safe)           <section>, h2 24px + lead
  Table label="Plan comparison", table-fixed, min-width 38rem; first column 34%, sticky left with an opaque background
    header: plan name (13px/600) + “Popular” badge + price (12px muted); recommended column tinted primary/10
    one TableBody per group: a rowgroup header (12px, uppercase, wide tracking, muted, transparent background)
      rows: <th scope="row"> feature + 3 cells: check (aria name “Included”), minus (“Not included”) or text
      recommended column cells tinted primary/5
    TableFooter: a small button per plan (primary for the recommended plan), aria-label “<cta>: <plan>”

FAQ (server-safe)                  <section>, 2 columns from @3xl (1fr / 1.6fr, gap 64), stacked below
  left: h2 28px, 15px muted text, “Email support” (outline, mail icon) + “Talk to sales →” (ghost) as links
  right: Accordion type="single" collapsible, first item open, triggers at heading level 3
```

#### Behaviour
- The switch is controlled; changing it rolls every price to the new value and rewrites the note: monthly “per seat / month, billed monthly”, yearly “per seat / month, billed yearly ($<12 × price>)”. Free stays “$0” with “Free forever, no card needed”.
- Prices: Starter 0/0, Pro 24/19, Business 49/39 (monthly/yearly per seat per month).
- Arrow keys move and select inside the segmented control (radiogroup); the pill glides on the morph spring.

#### Visual rules
- Gradient only as the faint background wash of the tiers section (marketing block rule). No gradients on cards or buttons, no shadows.
- The recommended card: border and a 1px ring in the primary colour (a 2px outline in effect), not a lift.
- Tabular figures on prices; reduced motion changes the digits without rolling.

#### Responsive
- Container queries. Cards stack below 48rem; the comparison table scrolls horizontally inside its focusable frame with the feature column pinned; the FAQ stacks below 48rem.

#### Accessibility
- Sections are labelled by their headings; plan features are lists named “<Plan> features”.
- The price is read as plain text (AnimatedNumber exposes the formatted value to screen readers).
- Table features are row headers; group rows use scope="rowgroup"; check and minus icons have accessible names.

#### Acceptance checks
- Clicking Yearly changes Pro to $19 and its note to “billed yearly ($228)”; Monthly brings back $24.
- Only one card has a primary button and the “Most popular” badge.
- At 390px the cards are one column, and the comparison table scrolls while “Seats” stays visible.
- The first FAQ answer is open on load; opening another closes it.

### Three tiers

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { AnimatedNumber } from '@/ui/components/animated-counter';
import { Badge } from '@/ui/components/badge';
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { SegmentedControl, SegmentedControlItem } from '@/ui/components/toggle-group';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

type Period = 'monthly' | 'yearly';

const PLANS = [
  {
    id: 'starter',
    name: 'Starter',
    description: 'For freelancers and very small teams getting their books in order.',
    price: { monthly: 0, yearly: 0 },
    cta: 'Start for free',
    features: ['Up to 3 seats', '1 bank connection', 'Invoices and expenses', 'Monthly reports', 'Email support'],
  },
  {
    id: 'pro',
    name: 'Pro',
    description: 'For growing teams that close every month and need approvals.',
    price: { monthly: 24, yearly: 19 },
    cta: 'Start 14-day trial',
    popular: true,
    features: ['Unlimited seats', 'Unlimited bank connections', 'Approval workflows', 'Live cash-flow forecast', 'Priority chat support'],
  },
  {
    id: 'business',
    name: 'Business',
    description: 'For finance teams with audits, entities and an IT department.',
    price: { monthly: 49, yearly: 39 },
    cta: 'Talk to sales',
    features: ['Everything in Pro', 'Multiple entities and currencies', 'SAML single sign-on', 'Audit log and data retention', 'Named account manager'],
  },
] as const;

/** Marketing block: one subtle wash of the primary colour behind the heading (design rule D2). */
const WASH = 'radial-gradient(60% 40% at 50% 0%, color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-primary) 9%, transparent), transparent)';

const usd = { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD', maximumFractionDigits: 0 } as const;

function billingNote(price: { monthly: number; yearly: number }, period: Period) {
  if (price.monthly === 0) return 'Free forever, no card needed';
  if (period === 'monthly') return 'per seat / month, billed monthly';
  return `per seat / month, billed yearly ($${price.yearly * 12})`;
}

export default function PricingTiers() {
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState<Period>('monthly');

  return (
    <section
      aria-labelledby="pricing-title"
      className="@container w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-5 py-14 @2xl:px-10"
      style={{ backgroundImage: WASH }}
    >
      <div className="mx-auto grid max-w-2xl justify-items-center gap-4 text-center">
        <Badge variant="outline">Pricing</Badge>
        <h2 id="pricing-title" className="font-display text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight @2xl:text-4xl">
          Plans that grow with your team
        </h2>
        <p className="max-w-xl text-md text-muted-foreground">
          Start free, upgrade when you need approvals and forecasting. Every paid plan includes a 14-day trial and you can cancel at any time.
        </p>
        <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-3">
          <SegmentedControl value={period} onValueChange={(v) => setPeriod(v as Period)} aria-label="Billing period">
            <SegmentedControlItem value="monthly">Monthly</SegmentedControlItem>
            <SegmentedControlItem value="yearly">Yearly</SegmentedControlItem>
          </SegmentedControl>
          <Badge variant="success" size="sm">
            Save 20% yearly
          </Badge>
        </div>
      </div>

      <ul className="mx-auto mt-12 grid max-w-5xl items-start gap-4 @3xl:grid-cols-3" aria-label="Plans">
        {PLANS.map((plan) => {
          const popular = 'popular' in plan && plan.popular;
          return (
            <li
              key={plan.id}
              data-plan={plan.id}
              className={
                popular
                  ? 'relative grid gap-6 rounded-xl border border-primary bg-card p-6 ring-1 ring-primary'
                  : 'relative grid gap-6 rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-6'
              }
            >
              <div className="grid gap-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <h3 id={`plan-${plan.id}`} className="text-lg font-semibold">
                    {plan.name}
                  </h3>
                  {popular && (
                    <Badge solid size="sm">
                      Most popular
                    </Badge>
                  )}
                </div>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{plan.description}</p>
              </div>

              <div className="grid gap-1">
                <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1.5">
                  <AnimatedNumber value={plan.price[period]} format={usd} className="font-display text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight" />
                  {plan.price.monthly > 0 && <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">/ seat</span>}
                </div>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground" data-billing-note>
                  {billingNote(plan.price, period)}
                </p>
              </div>

              <Button variant={popular ? 'primary' : 'outline'} className="w-full">
                {plan.cta}
              </Button>

              <ul className="grid gap-2.5 border-t border-border pt-5 text-sm" aria-label={`${plan.name} features`}>
                {plan.features.map((f) => (
                  <li key={f} className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                    <Icon name="check" size={16} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-primary-text" />
                    {f}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>

      <p className="mt-8 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        Prices in USD, excluding VAT. Non-profits and schools get 50% off,{' '}
        <a href="#contact" className="font-medium text-primary-text hover:underline">
          ask us
        </a>
        .
      </p>
    </section>
  );
}
```

### Feature comparison

File: `components/blocks/pricing/comparison.tsx` (docs source: `apps/docs/examples/blocks/pricing/comparison.tsx`)

```tsx
import { Badge } from '@/ui/components/badge';
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableFooter, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/ui/components/table';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

type Value = boolean | string;

const PLANS = [
  { id: 'starter', name: 'Starter', price: 'Free', cta: 'Start free' },
  { id: 'pro', name: 'Pro', price: '$24 / seat', cta: 'Start trial', popular: true },
  { id: 'business', name: 'Business', price: '$49 / seat', cta: 'Talk to sales' },
];

const GROUPS: { title: string; rows: [feature: string, starter: Value, pro: Value, business: Value][] }[] = [
  {
    title: 'Usage',
    rows: [
      ['Seats', 'Up to 3', 'Unlimited', 'Unlimited'],
      ['Bank connections', '1', 'Unlimited', 'Unlimited'],
      ['Entities', '1', '1', 'Up to 25'],
      ['Transaction history', '12 months', '7 years', 'Unlimited'],
    ],
  },
  {
    title: 'Features',
    rows: [
      ['Invoices and expenses', true, true, true],
      ['Approval workflows', false, true, true],
      ['Cash-flow forecast', false, true, true],
      ['Multi-currency', false, false, true],
      ['API access', false, 'Read only', 'Read and write'],
    ],
  },
  {
    title: 'Security',
    rows: [
      ['Two-factor authentication', true, true, true],
      ['SAML single sign-on', false, false, true],
      ['Audit log', false, '30 days', 'Unlimited'],
    ],
  },
  {
    title: 'Support',
    rows: [
      ['Help centre and email', true, true, true],
      ['Priority chat', false, true, true],
      ['Named account manager', false, false, true],
      ['Uptime SLA', false, false, '99.95%'],
    ],
  },
];

/** Sticky first column: stays put while the plan columns scroll sideways on narrow screens. */
const STICKY = 'sticky left-0 z-10';
/** The recommended plan's column gets a faint tint. */
const HIGHLIGHT = 'bg-primary/5';

function Cell({ value }: { value: Value }) {
  if (value === true) return <Icon name="check" size={18} label="Included" className="inline-block text-primary-text" />;
  if (value === false) return <Icon name="minus" size={18} label="Not included" className="inline-block text-muted-foreground" />;
  return <span className="text-foreground">{value}</span>;
}

export default function PricingComparison() {
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="compare-title" className="@container grid w-full gap-6 rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-4 py-10 @2xl:px-10">
      <div className="grid gap-2">
        <h2 id="compare-title" className="font-display text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
          Compare plans
        </h2>
        <p className="text-base text-muted-foreground">Every feature, side by side. Scroll sideways on small screens.</p>
      </div>

      <Table label="Plan comparison" className="min-w-[38rem] table-fixed" wrapperClassName="bg-card">
        <colgroup>
          <col className="w-[34%]" />
          {PLANS.map((p) => (
            <col key={p.id} />
          ))}
        </colgroup>
        <TableHeader>
          <TableRow>
            <TableHead className={`${STICKY} bg-muted`}>
              <span className="sr-only">Feature</span>
            </TableHead>
            {PLANS.map((p) => (
              <TableHead key={p.id} align="center" className={p.popular ? 'h-auto py-4 bg-primary/10' : 'h-auto py-4'}>
                <span className="grid justify-items-center gap-1 whitespace-normal">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">
                    {p.name}
                    {p.popular && (
                      <Badge size="sm" solid>
                        Popular
                      </Badge>
                    )}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">{p.price}</span>
                </span>
              </TableHead>
            ))}
          </TableRow>
        </TableHeader>
        {GROUPS.map((group) => (
          <TableBody key={group.title}>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead scope="rowgroup" colSpan={4} className="h-auto bg-transparent pt-6 pb-2 text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide text-muted-foreground uppercase">
                <span className="sticky left-4">{group.title}</span>
              </TableHead>
            </TableRow>
            {group.rows.map(([feature, ...values]) => (
              <TableRow key={feature}>
                <TableHead scope="row" className={`${STICKY} h-12 bg-card text-sm font-normal whitespace-normal text-foreground`}>
                  {feature}
                </TableHead>
                {values.map((v, i) => (
                  <TableCell key={PLANS[i]!.id} align="center" className={PLANS[i]!.popular ? HIGHLIGHT : undefined}>
                    <Cell value={v} />
                  </TableCell>
                ))}
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        ))}
        <TableFooter>
          <TableRow>
            <TableCell className={STICKY} />
            {PLANS.map((p) => (
              <TableCell key={p.id} align="center" className={p.popular ? `${HIGHLIGHT} py-4` : 'py-4'}>
                <Button size="sm" variant={p.popular ? 'primary' : 'outline'} aria-label={`${p.cta}: ${p.name}`}>
                  {p.cta}
                </Button>
              </TableCell>
            ))}
          </TableRow>
        </TableFooter>
      </Table>
    </section>
  );
}
```

### FAQ

```tsx
import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger } from '@/ui/components/accordion';
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

const FAQ = [
  {
    q: 'How does the 14-day trial work?',
    a: 'You get every Pro feature for 14 days, no card needed. We email you three days before it ends. If you don’t pick a plan, your workspace moves to Starter and nothing is deleted.',
  },
  {
    q: 'What counts as a seat?',
    a: 'Anyone who can sign in to your workspace. Accountants you invite as read-only guests are free and don’t use a seat.',
  },
  {
    q: 'Can I switch between monthly and yearly billing?',
    a: 'Yes, from Settings → Billing. Moving to yearly applies straight away and we credit what’s left of your month. Moving to monthly starts when your year ends.',
  },
  {
    q: 'Do you offer refunds?',
    a: 'Yearly plans can be refunded in full within 30 days of payment. Monthly plans aren’t refunded once the month has started, but you can cancel at any time.',
  },
  {
    q: 'Where is my data stored?',
    a: 'In the EU (Frankfurt) by default, encrypted at rest and in transit. Business workspaces can choose the US (Virginia) or the UK (London) instead.',
  },
  {
    q: 'Do you have discounts for non-profits?',
    a: 'Registered non-profits, schools and open-source projects get 50% off any paid plan. Email us from your organisation’s domain to apply.',
  },
];

export default function PricingFaq() {
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="faq-title" className="@container w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-5 py-12 @2xl:px-10">
      <div className="grid gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1.6fr)] @3xl:gap-16">
        <div className="grid content-start gap-3">
          <h2 id="faq-title" className="font-display text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
            Frequently asked questions
          </h2>
          <p className="text-md text-muted-foreground">Can’t find what you’re looking for? Our team usually replies within two hours on weekdays.</p>
          <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <Button variant="outline" asChild>
              <a href="mailto:support@lumen.dev">
                <Icon name="mail" />
                Email support
              </a>
            </Button>
            <Button variant="ghost" asChild>
              <a href="#contact-sales">
                Talk to sales
                <Icon name="arrow-right" />
              </a>
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Accordion type="single" collapsible defaultValue="faq-0">
          {FAQ.map((item, i) => (
            <AccordionItem key={item.q} value={`faq-${i}`}>
              <AccordionTrigger headingLevel={3}>{item.q}</AccordionTrigger>
              <AccordionContent>{item.a}</AccordionContent>
            </AccordionItem>
          ))}
        </Accordion>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```
